To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the dynamics of the participation of small farmers in high value export chains are affected by the transaction risks they face, that opportunistic behavior has a negative effect on trust and that market arrangements can affect the transaction risks and relational trust between farmers and agribusiness firms.

(1) the probability of small farmers' exit is higher in periods of economic crisis, (2) opportunistic behavior reduces the trust of small farmers, (3) small farmers' participation in the pineapple chain is positively affected by the presence of a cooperative, and (4) the adoption of standards increases transaction risks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of the dynamics that take place in the relationship between small farmers and export companies.
the analysis of the dynamics and sustainability of small farmers' participation in high value export chains.
the dynamics of high value chains in developing countries and their impact on small farmers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the dynamics of the high value chains are affected by transaction risk and opportunistic behavior.
the smallholders in both cases are facing a high degree of uncertainty in their marketing relationships and are exposed to high transaction risks.
the dynamics of smallholders' participation are complex and depend on several factors, including the characteristics of the product and the chain.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the participation of small farmers in export chains has a positive and sustained impact on their welfare.
smallholders' participation is not only determined by initial access to export markets, but is also affected by the dynamics of the chain over time.
the dynamics of the smallholders' participation are driven by a combination of market and non-market factors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
small farmers' access to the export markets has been increasing over time, but that the dynamics of their participation are affected by transaction risk.
the dynamics of high value chains are affected by transaction costs and the relational capital between actors, which are in turn determined by the market arrangements.
the participation of smallholders in high value export chains can be a promising strategy to improve their welfare and contribute to rural economic development.
